description: This file contains a shell script for configuring and managing WWAN (Wireless Wide Area Network) connections within an OpenWRT-based environment. It includes functions to initialize configuration, setup and teardown WWAN interfaces, and dynamically load protocol-specific scripts based on detected hardware and configuration.
